name: alps
description: Turn recurring agent work into reusable, assessable Process Skills with explicit Outcomes, traceable handoffs, and controlled improvement.

interface.longDescription: ALPS turns recurring agent work into reusable, assessable Process Skills. It makes Purpose, success conditions, boundaries, Inputs, Outputs, and applicable conditions explicit; composes Processes through traceable handoffs; and uses verification and execution evidence to support controlled assessment and improvement.
capabilities: Define reusable work with explicit Outcomes
Compose Process Skills with traceable handoffs
defaultPrompt: Turn this recurring work into a reusable Process Skill with explicit Outcomes, Inputs, Outputs, and verification criteria.
Review this Skill Package for unclear boundaries, unresolved references, and unsupported Conformance claims.
Compose these Process Skills into one workflow and map every Output-to-Input handoff.
